newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.302 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.302 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.302 percent, up from the previous issue's 1.210 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on July 24, raised 1,001.6 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.672 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on July 17, raised 791.90 million and was priced at 99.695 percent.
